notes: RoutrToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named Routr Network (ROUTR) with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the entire 1,000,000,000 token supply once to msg.sender, the launch factory. There are no application contracts or initialization calls. pool.initialPrice records provenance; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
